name: CR123A

dimensions.note: Height includes the positive terminal. Datasheet drawing gives the positive terminal diameter as 9.6 mm maximum and height as 1.0 mm minimum.

negative.note: Flat contact area 11.0 mm minimum diameter, recessed 0.5 to 0.9 mm in the can end.

geometry.note: Contact dimensions from the Energizer 123 datasheet drawing.

capacity_mah.conditions: Energizer 123: 100 ohm continuous to 2.0 V, 21 °C. Panasonic CR123A lists 1,550 mAh nominal at a 20 mA continuous drain.

variants.notes: Panasonic rates its CR123A for -40 to 70 °C operation, with a note to consult Panasonic outside -20 to 60 °C. Energizer weight 16.5 g, Panasonic about 16.0 g.

devices: Medical devices such as automated external defibrillators

interchange.note: A 16340 (RCR123A) lithium-ion battery has nearly the same size but charges to 4.2 V and runs at 3.6 to 3.7 V, so some devices designed for a 3.0 V single-use battery can be damaged or give wrong readings.

safety: Lithium photo batteries are single-use and are not designed to be recharged; charging can cause venting, fire or rupture.
Do not short-circuit, crush, heat or disassemble. The battery contains a positive temperature coefficient (PTC) device to limit short-circuit current, but it does not make the battery safe to abuse.
Replace all batteries in a device at the same time and do not mix them with used batteries or other types.
A rechargeable 3.7 V lithium-ion battery sold in this size is a different product (see 16340) and must not be used where a 3.0 V single-use battery is specified unless the device maker allows it.
notes: The IEC code CR17345 encodes a diameter of 17 mm and a height of 34.5 mm. The name 123A is a consumer name that has no relation to the A (17 mm by 50 mm) cell size.
